title: Daily Temperatures
description:
For each day, find how many days you have to wait until a warmer temperature. If there is no future day that is warmer, the answer for that day is 0.

Input format
Line 1: n.
Line 2: n integers, the temperature of each day.

Output format
n integers on one line, separated by single spaces.
hints: A brute force compares each day with every later day. Which comparisons are wasted?
Scan days from left to right and keep a stack of days still waiting for a warmer day. A new temperature resolves every waiting day that was colder.

Keep indices on the stack; while the current temperature is strictly greater than the temperature at the top index, pop it and set its answer to current - popped index. Equal temperatures do not count as warmer.

examples.explanation: Day 0 (73) waits 1 day for 74; day 2 (75) waits 4 days for 76; the last day never gets a warmer day.
Each day is followed immediately by a warmer one, except the last.
